name: What is the difference between ceramic, glass, and natural stone backsplash tile?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between ceramic, glass, and natural stone backsplash tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ceramic subway tile is affordable, low-maintenance, and easy to clean, but offers a traditional look. Natural stone, such as marble or travertine, delivers high-end texture and unique veining, but it requires regular sealing to resist cooking grease, moisture, and stains. Glass tiles provide a luminous, modern finish and wipe clean effortlessly, but they show water spots and require specialized thin-set mortar during installation to avoid shadowing behind the glass. Your selection depends on whether you prioritize minimal upkeep or natural aesthetic variation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ceramic is budget-friendly and easy to clean, natural stone offers luxury but requires routine sealing, and glass provides a sleek look but requires specialized mortar.
